'''Leeks''' are an [[aboveground]] [[crop|garden vegetable]]. They can be planted in all seasons and are edible raw or [[cooking|cooked]].

Some [[Dwarf|dwarves]] [[preferences|like]] leeks for their ''taste''.


[[File:Leeks.JPG|thumb|center|300px|Admired for its ''taste''.]]


{{D for Dwarf}}

Some other dwarves like leeks for their ''spinning''.
